content.title: Papa John’s Touts Turnaround Plan but Stays 'Open-Minded'
content.summary: Papa John’s chief executive said the pizza chain has a turnaround strategy, but its board remains “open-minded” and will consider alternatives.  “To the extent there is an alternative to our strategy that is available and maximizes shareholder value, we would fully consider it,” Chief Executive Todd Penegor said Thursday.  Media reports this year have pointed to Papa John’s as a takeout target.
